title: run_app: fetch_session failure propagates before terminal cleanup runs
description: In main.rs, if client::fetch_session() fails in run_app(), the error propagates out of run_app() and then the cleanup block in main (disable_raw_mode + LeaveAlternateScreen) runs. This is correct. However, if the error occurs AFTER enable_raw_mode() and EnterAlternateScreen() in main but BEFORE run_app() returns, the terminal IS in raw mode and the cleanup block does run. But run_app() is structured as: enable raw mode in main → call run_app → cleanup in main. The issue: run_app calls fetch_session() which can block indefinitely if the server hangs (no timeout set — see KITH-hqrw.44). During this hang the raw terminal has no input handling, so the user cannot Ctrl-C. The panic hook does restore the terminal on panic, but a network hang is not a panic. The user is stuck in a black terminal until the OS-level TCP timeout fires (~2 minutes on Linux). This is a usability/maintenance consequence of missing timeout.
